fin.softbank.note: Source: SoftBank Group FY2025 (year to 31.03.2026), consolidated P&L (driver — Arm/SBKK); holdco metrics (NAV/LTV/debt) — SOTP page [3], Bloomberg [17]. All figures in ¥ bn unless stated otherwise. SoftBank Group is a holding company: the metric that matters is NAV and the discount to NAV (~49%), not the operating P&L. The full multi-year ROIC table (per-share, working capital, quarters, return vs S&P) is not filled in — it needs a ROIC export for SFTBY (US ADR). Figures for 9434.T (SoftBank Corp) are a separate telecom subsidiary and are NOT used here.
